items.title: The Jacobi-Zariski sequence of a formally smooth local homomorphism at the residue field

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the beginning of the Jacobi-Zariski sequence for a formally smooth local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings at the residue field of the target: it shows that the connecting term H_1 of the naive cotangent complex injects into the cotangent space, so the sequence starts with a zero on the left. The proof reduces to that injectivity by quoting the exactness of the Jacobi-Zariski sequence and the identification of the cotangent space with H_1 of the relative naive cotangent complex, then rewrites the domain of the arrow through the sequence of the residue field extension, produces a short exact sequence for the cotangent spaces via the conormal sequence of a regular quotient, compares the two rows in a commutative diagram, and finishes by the snake lemma once injectivity of the left vertical arrow is known from the regular-fibre theorem. The argument is short but uses four external ingredients, each quoted exactly.
